one_line: Regulators act, AI spending soars, and safety measures rise after breaches.

themes.title: Regulators tighten AI oversight
themes.text: UK courts upheld Ofcom’s data‑moderation requests and the Competition Authority opened a probe into Meta’s publisher terms. India’s TRAI released draft AI governance rules and major AI providers adopted a shared robots.txt opt‑out signal.

stories.headline: UK high court rejects Meta, TikTok and X challenge to Ofcom data requests
UK competition regulator probes Meta's terms for publishers and advertisers
TRAI drafts AI policy framework requiring board approval and incident reporting for telecoms
OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic adopt shared robots.txt opt‑out standard
OpenAI says it will honor robots.txt signal for AI training preferences

themes.title: AI infrastructure spending hits trillions
themes.text: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Oracle disclosed over $3 trillion in data‑center commitments, prompting stock declines and cash‑flow concerns. Nvidia pledged $3 billion to Meta’s equity offering, while Baseten raised $2 billion and Foxconn, Runware and Fujifilm announced hardware and storage expansions.

stories.headline: Big tech firms commit over $3 trillion to AI data‑center spending
US tech stocks tumble as AI spending approaches $1 trillion
Nvidia commits $3 billion to Meta share sale and expands AI infrastructure partnership
Baseten launches $2 billion funding round, valuation up to $30 billion
Foxconn says new collaboration with OpenAI in works, denies AI bubble
Runware plans factory to mass‑produce AI pods at car‑assembly line speed
Fujifilm to boost magnetic tape production fivefold as AI drives data archiving

themes.title: New safety measures after breaches
themes.text: Chinese state‑linked hackers used DeepSeek via ARTEX to target hundreds of firms, and a malicious Claude Code VS Code extension attempted to install an SSH backdoor. OpenAI responded with tighter teen weapons limits and broader violence‑prevention safeguards for ChatGPT.

stories.headline: China‑linked hackers used DeepSeek AI via ARTEX to breach 200+ firms in 11 days
Malicious Claude Code VS Code extension adds SSH backdoor, affecting up to 5,000 users
OpenAI tightens weapons‑related information limits for teen ChatGPT users
OpenAI adds expanded safeguards to ChatGPT for violence prevention
